item.title: PostgreSQL 18 and pgvector: Building AI-Native Applications on Postgres in 2026
item.description: Every few months another vector database shows up with a slick landing page and a Series A. Meanwhile the database most of us already run in production quietly picked up everything it needed to do the same job. I spent the last couple of weeks moving a small RAG prototype off a dedicated vector store and onto plain PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector, mostly out of curiosity about whether it would actually hold up.

item.title: PostgreSQL CRUD App with Python & Neon
item.description: In this session, we’ll build a clean, object-oriented PostgreSQL CRUD application using Python and Neon, a modern serverless PostgreSQL platform. The best part? No local PostgreSQL installation is required. Watch on YouTube This article is perfect for: Python developers learning databases Backend beginners Developers preparing for interviews Anyone exploring cloud PostgreSQL with Neon Why Neon PostgreSQL? Neon is a serverless, cloud-based PostgreSQL provider that removes the pain of local database setup.
